items.t: What Could Tightening Supply Mean For Prologis (PLD) Through 2027?
items.sum: Prologis (NYSE:PLD) research flagged a supply and demand gap in industrial real estate that it says is widening into 2027. The firm reported that rents would need to climb substantially for new logistics projects to be economically viable under current cost conditions. items.t: Prologis: Rents Must Climb 27% to Justify New Warehouses
items.sum: Most new logistics projects need 27% higher rents to pencil, setting up tighter supply and stronger rents and occupancy through 2027.

Is Prologis (PLD) Below Fair Value After Its $5b ATM Offering?
items.sum: Prologis (PLD) has moved back into the equity market, filing a US$5b at-the-market follow-on offering and immediately placing US$71.8m of common stock with investors. That equity raise drops into a stock that has been treading water in the shorter term, with a 1 month share price return of 0.82% and a 90 day share price decline of 6.42%.
